name: Trail Edge (COMPAS CEM)
description: Create a trail edge from a line.

inputParameters.name: line
inputParameters.description: A line that defines the end nodes of the edge.

inputParameters.name: state
inputParameters.description: The force state of the edge: positive for tension, negative for compression. Only its sign is used, and it must be nonzero. Optional with a plane: the topology then records it, for drawing and for a trail that never meets the plane, while the solver ends the trail at the plane.

inputParameters.name: length
inputParameters.description: The length of the edge. Only its absolute value is used. Connect either a length or a plane.

inputParameters.name: plane
inputParameters.description: A plane that ends the edge where its trail meets it, instead of a length. The plane's position sets the force state the solver finds.
